play_plan.meaning: Real F1: a rival has just gone out on his first qualifying run, so a fast lap is about to come past you on track.
play_plan.when_it_should_play: Qualifying (SessionType 5, FACT findings.jsonl:63). An AI rival (controller_role==1) leaves the pit exit (pit_status 4) to start its 1 flying run; the player is on track. Race (7) excluded.
play_plan.trigger: Per AI car, on the transition pit_status 3->4 or 2->4 (broker vehicle snapshot pit_status; veh+0x3450, CONFIRMED traffic_density_commentary.c:17). Run counter = number of such exits this session for that car + 1 (ERE-side counter, latched). Fire when counter == 1. State reads: session_type (session snapshot, FACT), controller_role, pit_status, driver_id.
play_plan.subject: AI driver: the rival car's driver id, veh+0x489C (HAIKU_BRIEF; f1c_pit_voice.h). Broker field: driver_id (f1c_broker_abi.h F1CBrokerVehicleSnapshot).
play_plan.technique: own_emitter: ERE queues the PWS eid through DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion(buf, eid, veh+0x489C) + InsertDriverTableEntry(flt_5EA618, buf) (f1c_pit_voice.h; PWS eid mapping CONFIRMED by findings.jsonl:121 low-eid identity twin).
play_plan.latch_cooldown: once per AI car per run number (one fire per car per run); plus 60 s global floor on any PWS line
play_plan.must_not_play_when: Race session (7). Player's own car (controller_role==0). Car in the pit lane (pit_status 1-3) or on the formation/grid exit at session start (no real run started). Any AI penalty line (DD-10). Counter not reset on session restart.
play_plan.conflicts: MF 1.0.7 does not rewrite any event-table row at load (coordinator census addendum; DD-07). It uses the eid only as a token while its own line is pending (dll/mf_voice.h:60-68). ERE must skip or delay queuing this eid while MF has a pending line on it. No block when MF is merely loaded. Also: 'AI pit' lines (eids 21/22 AISessionPhaseChange, eid 22 = PWS_2001_21) and PWS_2001_17-20 should not fire in the same frame; AI position lines (AIPositionChangeEvent eids 7/8/9/17/18) can overlap.
play_plan.calibration: Run counter definition (the game has no run counter in corpus, DERIVED from design H7). Exit-transition: confirm pit_status==4 is written on pit exit (UNKNOWN live). Decide whether a session-start exit counts as run 1.
play_plan.live_test: Owner: qualifying, run with AI on track. Watch one AI car go through its pit exit 1 times, with the eid in the ERE log. Expect the line once per car per run. Check it does not play in the race. Requires MF token move first.
play_plan.confidence: GUESS. The transition predicate is DERIVED; the run counter and exit semantics are unproven (H7 tier GUESS). Raise with a live pit-exit trace of one AI car.

play_plan.meaning: Real F1: a rival has just gone out on his fourth qualifying run.
play_plan.when_it_should_play: Qualifying (SessionType 5, FACT findings.jsonl:63). An AI rival (controller_role==1) leaves the pit exit (pit_status 4) to start its 4 flying run; the player is on track. Race (7) excluded.
play_plan.trigger: Per AI car, on the transition pit_status 3->4 or 2->4 (broker vehicle snapshot pit_status; veh+0x3450, CONFIRMED traffic_density_commentary.c:17). Run counter = number of such exits this session for that car + 1 (ERE-side counter, latched). Fire when counter == 4. State reads: session_type (session snapshot, FACT), controller_role, pit_status, driver_id.
play_plan.subject: AI driver: the rival car's driver id, veh+0x489C (HAIKU_BRIEF; f1c_pit_voice.h). Broker field: driver_id (f1c_broker_abi.h F1CBrokerVehicleSnapshot).
play_plan.technique: own_emitter: ERE queues the PWS eid through DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion(buf, eid, veh+0x489C) + InsertDriverTableEntry(flt_5EA618, buf) (f1c_pit_voice.h; PWS eid mapping CONFIRMED by findings.jsonl:121 low-eid identity twin).
play_plan.latch_cooldown: once per AI car per run number (one fire per car per run); plus 60 s global floor on any PWS line
play_plan.must_not_play_when: Race session (7). Player's own car (controller_role==0). Car in the pit lane (pit_status 1-3) or on the formation/grid exit at session start (no real run started). Any AI penalty line (DD-10). Counter not reset on session restart.
play_plan.conflicts: MF 1.0.7 does not rewrite any event-table row at load (coordinator census addendum; DD-07). It uses the eid only as a token while its own line is pending (dll/mf_voice.h:60-68). ERE must skip or delay queuing this eid while MF has a pending line on it. No block when MF is merely loaded. Also: 'AI pit' lines (eids 21/22 AISessionPhaseChange, eid 22 = PWS_2001_21) and PWS_2001_17-20 should not fire in the same frame; AI position lines (AIPositionChangeEvent eids 7/8/9/17/18) can overlap.
play_plan.calibration: Run counter definition (the game has no run counter in corpus, DERIVED from design H7). Exit-transition: confirm pit_status==4 is written on pit exit (UNKNOWN live). Decide whether a session-start exit counts as run 1.
play_plan.live_test: Owner: qualifying, run with AI on track. Watch one AI car go through its pit exit 4 times, with the eid in the ERE log. Expect the line once per car per run. Check it does not play in the race. Requires MF token move first.
play_plan.confidence: GUESS. The transition predicate is DERIVED; the run counter and exit semantics are unproven (H7 tier GUESS). Raise with a live pit-exit trace of one AI car.

play_plan.meaning: Real F1: the car just ahead of you is on a flying lap in qualifying. Don't block it; hold back and give it room.
play_plan.when_it_should_play: Session 5 (qualifying). The player is directly behind an AI car A on a FLYING lap (pit_status 0, not out-lap, not in-lap) and A is ahead by a small lap-distance gap.
play_plan.trigger: session_type == 5 (session snapshot, FACT). Player: controller_role == 0. A: controller_role == 1, pit_status == 0, not on out-lap (pit exit edge 4->0 not within this lap), not in-lap (pit_status 1 or callToBox == 0). Track order: gap = lap_distance(A) - lap_distance(player) (veh+0x4044, lap-wrap mod lap length), gap in (0, GAP_M] metres, GAP_M UNKNOWN (propose 100 m; convert distance units live). Heading check optional: world_x/y/z vector dot yaw (veh+0x34BC..0x34E0, FACT) > 0 to confirm A is ahead, not beside. Lap state detector (DERIVED, from broker/veh fields): OUT-LAP = first lap after the pit exit edge pit_status 4->0. IN-LAP = pit_status == 1 or callToBox set. FLYING = neither, on track (pit_status == 0). Track order = lap distance veh+0x4044 (CONFIRMED, findings f1c-race-position-is-4060-not-32d0 notes 0x4044 is lap distance; NOT 0x4048), with lap-wrap handling; gap in metres = lap-distance difference, with lap-wrap. race_position (veh+0x4060) is timing-sheet order and is NOT used for 'ahead' in qualifying.
play_plan.subject: AI driver: the rival car's driver id, veh+0x489C (HAIKU_BRIEF; f1c_pit_voice.h). Broker field: driver_id (f1c_broker_abi.h F1CBrokerVehicleSnapshot). The rival AI car A is the subject; the player is the listener.
play_plan.technique: own_emitter (ERE queues the PWS eid; PWS mapping CONFIRMED findings.jsonl:121).
play_plan.latch_cooldown: once per AI car A per lap; plus 60 s global floor
play_plan.must_not_play_when: Race (7). Player in pit lane (pit_status != 0). A in pit lane or on in/out lap. A behind the player (negative gap or wrap far away). Lap distance unchanged for two frames (stopped car). Player's own car. No AI penalty context (DD-10).
play_plan.conflicts: MF 1.0.7 does not rewrite any event-table row at load (coordinator census addendum; DD-07). It uses the eid only as a token while its own line is pending (dll/mf_voice.h:60-68). ERE must skip or delay queuing this eid while MF has a pending line on it. No block when MF is merely loaded. AIPositionChangeEvent (sub_4198B0) quali lines use eids 7/8/9/17/18 and can overlap in meaning; keep one fire per event.
play_plan.calibration: GAP_M in metres and the lap-distance unit (veh+0x4044 scale); lap length per track for wrap; whether a heading check is needed.
play_plan.live_test: Owner: qualifying, sit 1-2 car lengths behind an AI on a flying lap. The line should fire once per lap. Control: same gap with the AI on an in-lap must NOT fire (eid 31 case); the player on an out-lap must not fire.
play_plan.confidence: DERIVED for the track order and lap-state detector; GUESS for GAP_M and the heading check (calibrate live).
